reviewed_by: Codex focused iPhone assistant coverage review, 2026-10-14
reason: The changed journey is the paired installed iPhone shell opening Core-backed chats, showing and resolving chat-origin attention, and surviving reload and reconnect. The selected API test checks authentication, cross-project pending action filtering, ordering, and resolution. Product-knowledge checks cover the changed guidance source digest and Core index sync. Component tests check Core-authoritative badge refresh, failed retry polling, and separation of unreachable Core from revoked pairing. One exact shell journey is run across permanent desktop at 1440/1024, phone Chromium/WebKit widths, and landscape profiles; one existing mobile WebKit Workbench journey checks ordinary mobile browser access remains intact. The paired production-LAN real-Core case exercises streaming, approval, persistence, and outage recovery with an inert harness.
exclusions: No native Swift or Rust source changed, so native tests are excluded. Unrelated Python, frontend, browser, and full suites are excluded. Physical signed-iPhone keyboard, rotation, background and native pairing behavior require separate device evidence before merge. Local Python collection uses the available 3.11 environment; CI selects supported 3.12.
